firmware.body_firmware_evidence: version string found at offset 0x26240 in firmware.fdat; owner confirms the body was updated to 2.03
firmware.note: Every fastboot/BootROM success in dino2048/zv-e10-toolkit is tied to 2.02 (30110_05). No 2.03 BootROM/fastboot success record exists in that repo. Upstream also built a separate 'Jiritsu' backend for 2.03 because the legacy terminal protocol fails there (FileControl returns 0x80). Whether 2.03 closed the BootROM serial entry is NOT yet confirmed - asked upstream directly.
firmware.probable_root_cause: firmware 2.03 vs 2.02 behaviour change at the BootROM serial-entry gate

authorship.note: All reverse engineering, waveform measurement, protocol implementation and triage were done by an AI agent; the owner performed wiring, multimeter readings and power cycling.

state.root_cause: /etc/ld.so.preload points at a crashing shared object; glibc 2.11.2 treats preload failure as fatal, so every execve fails and init never starts
state.symptom: reboot loop every ~2.66 s; no UI; USB enumerates only 054C:0994
fix_actions: make /etc/ld.so.preload empty (nflasha10, partition offset 0x0AC00000, 12 MiB vfat)
OR create /setting/sen/smode containing 'UU' (nflasha2, offset 0x00800000) to force the USB service interface from the initramfs

boot_timing_measured.method: RK3588 as USB host, dmesg timestamps
boot_timing_measured.settled_state: pure charging, SoC no longer boots; OFF->ON restarts cycling

wiring_verified.A9: VBUS 5.15 V (true value; meter reads 7.8 V, meter is 51.5% high, NOT 21%)
wiring_verified.B5: tied to the A5 node, so CC2 is also pulled through the same 5.1k (DAM condition), B5 ~0 V
wiring_verified.A7: data, open-drain, no series resistor; path drop measured ~0 V
wiring_verified.A6: 470 ohm to XRESET_REQ; path drop ~0 V
wiring_verified.correction: Earlier claims of 'camera-side pull-up 1.73 V' are NOT reliable: pinctrl showed gpio1-7/gpio1-8 held 'input bias pull up', so our own bias was in the reading.

excluded_channels: BootROM serial injection via A7/A6 (correct waveform, zero response, no 0x100D) - on firmware 2.03 this layer may simply not be reachable; see firmware section
Loader UART (ldr_drv.bin uses GPIO2 peripherals 0xF2910000 / 0xF2912000, not USB-C)
userland shell / service mode / mass storage / WiFi / Bluetooth
ADJUST / BIS forced boot modes (set by Loader via Backup_read; dead variables in initramfs)
SD-card updater / MS Boot (real 371 MB BODYDATA.DAT, behaviour unchanged)
USB 054C:0994 (single IN interrupt endpoint, no output or feature reports)
HDMI CEC / hot shoe / mic / headphone
direct eMMC access / JTAG (BGA, requires soldering)
experiments_2026_11_27: plug flipped 180 degrees (equivalent to using B7/B6 because a 16-pin receptacle bridges A7 and B7): no response
isolated measurement with our wires removed (camera side only): results inconsistent between runs, marked unreliable
nanosecond sampling of D- for 18 s: 0 transitions (proves the camera never drives the idle line, NOT that the pin is disconnected)
USB-identity criterion: inject official stage1, swap to a plain USB-C data cable, watch /sys/bus/usb -> only 054c:0994, never ZVE10-fastboot or 18d1:4ee0
corrections_2026_11_27: multimeter reads 51.5% high, not 21% (3V3 true 3.30 V read as 5.0 V; 5V true 5.15 V read as 7.8 V); true = reading / 1.515
earlier 'camera-side pull-up 1.73 V' is not established: our own gpio bias was enabled
one whole round of 'D- = 0 V so the wire is broken' was wrong: the probe was driving the line at the time

upstream_reference.note: The documented success was achieved on the upstream project's own camera (GitHub user qn06142), not on this unit. But firmware difference is now the stronger explanation: that camera was on 2.02, this one is on 2.03.

open_question: Has BootROM serial injection ever worked on firmware 2.03 (30110_06.2026060501)? Asked upstream: https://github.com/dino2048/zv-e10-toolkit/issues/8#issuecomment-7220609429
